[SWS_Rte_91193]

CopyRxData
Status:

⌈
Service Name
Rte_[<Partition>_]COMCbkCopyRxData (draft)
Syntax
BufReq_ReturnType Rte_[<Partition>_]COMCbkCopyRxData (
CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId,
const PduInfoType* info,
PduLengthType* bufferSizePtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0xA2
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant for same ComUserCbkHandleId, otherwise Reentrant
ComUserCbkHandleId
Com user callback handle Id corresponding to the received I-PDU
Parameters (in)
info
Provides the source buffer (SduDataPtr) and the number of bytes
to be copied (SduLength). An SduLength of 0 can be used to
query the current amount of available buffer in the upper layer
module. In this case, the SduDataPtr may be a NULL_PTR.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
bufferSizePtr
Available receive buffer after data has been copied.
▽
△
Return value
BufReq_ReturnType
BUFREQ_OK: Data copied successfully
BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK: Data was not copied because an error
occurred.
Description
This callback is generated when there is a read access configured for the data item associated
to the large data path (TP) PDU to be received. It is called to provide the received data of an
I-PDU segment (N-PDU) to the RTE. Each call to this function provides the next part of the
I-PDU data. The size of the remaining data is written to the position indicated by bufferSizePtr.
